method: Terminal model investment performance, constrained by bank cash ≥ €250,000 at quarter ends and after opening capital decisions in every tested case, no critical adjustments and no capacity scaling. 180 grid plans plus 17 local variants for each of up to eight cash-safe seeds. Model uncertainty checked across valuation, demand elasticity, dividend sentiment and payroll parity. This is a bounded search, not a global optimum. Valuation/demand/production and inventory approximations remain; no official-engine optimum is implied.
